Mahe Island's Port Victoria is Seychelles' principal cargo and cruise port, as well as the capital city (population around 25,000). Mahe is the country's largest Island - sized approx 157 km2 (61 mi2) and with population around 80,000 (or ~86% of Seychelles' total). The island's scenery features extensive gardens and tall mountains, while the surrounding beautiful coral reefs provide great opportunities for snorkeling. Tourists are also attracted by the rich heritage of Indian, Chinese, European and African cultures.

Seychelles' second largest island (Praslin) is just a 15 min flight from Victoria-Mahe.

Mahe Island was first visited by the Europeans in the early-17th-century (1609, by the British) and again in the mid-18th-century (1742, by the French). In 1756, the island was claimed for the King of France (Louis XV "the Beloved"/1715-74) and remained French until 1812. Between 1812-1976 (Seychelles' independence), Mahe was part of Great Britain.

Due to a shortage of housing, the island was greatly expanded through land reclamation (Bel Ombre and Port Victoria). Before Seychelles' independence (1976), Mahe was largely a private plantation owned by the Frichot family. In 1977, following a coup d’etat, all the Frichots were expelled from Seychelles.

Like most Seychelles islands, Mahe's economy is largely based on tourism, but also on commercial fishing and canning. Principal exports from Port Victoria (locode SCPOV) are vanilla, coconuts, coconut oil, fish, guano.

Seychelles International Airport (1971-opened) is approx 11 km (7 mi) southeast of Victoria. It is the country's principal/largest airport and the homebase of the national carrier Air Seychelles. A number of foreign airlines link via regularly scheduled flights Victoria-Mahe with Reunion (Saint-Denis), Mauritius (Port Louis), South Africa (Johannesburg), Ethiopia (Addis Ababa), Kenya (Nairobi), Sri Lanka (Colombo), Russia (Moscow), France (Paris), Israel (Tel Aviv), Turkey (Istanbul), UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Qatar (Doha).

Mahe Island Seychelles cruise terminal

Cruise ships to Mahe Island dock (anchor) at Victoria (Seychelles' capital). Mahe cruise port terminal is located at Port Victoria. It the capital of the island and the region’s deepest harbour located in the north-eastern part of the island. Victoria is famous with its export of good including guano, vanilla, soap, coconut oil, coconuts and tortoise shell.

Mahe cruise port terminal is 20 minutes from the city by walk. You can use taxi, bus services or rent a bike.

The official language is Creole, English and French are widely spoken. The local currency is Seychellois rupee, SCR. The cruising season is all year round. Mahe cruise port terminal is not a dedicated one but offers enough facilities.

Seychelles International Airport (SEZ or Aeroport de La pointe Larue, served by major international airlines) in close and there is frequent bus service from Mahe cruise port terminal.
